name: Quietus
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait massive canyon systems, and everything the light never reaches.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
the research outpost was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
